instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Lenis smooth scrolling is initialized cleanly on the window element.
Implement bilingual support (ES / EN) using a React context or clean state so programmers worldwide can view show descriptions.
Ensure all interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, modals, quote items) include explicit data-testid attributes for testing.
Connect the booking form to the FastAPI backend API `/api/quotes` for persistence and render quote requests at `/admin`.
Use standard JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files for React components.
Never leave transparent backgrounds on sticky headers or popups — use glassmorphism with heavy backdrop blur (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0B0A0C]/80).
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Avoid generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical Bento grids for shows.
Ensure text contrast meets WCAG AA standards (minimum 4.5:1 ratio).
All buttons must have distinct hover, focus, and active micro-interactions.
All interactive elements MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes.
